result.topic_en: A page of dated diary entries (Braunschweig and Göttingen) recording results: a new proof of the Pythagorean theorem, the zeros of a power series, iterated logarithms, representation of numbers as sums of three squares, the composition of forces, an extension of Lagrange's transformation theorem, a series summing to 4/π, and a defence of the probability calculus against Laplace.
result.transcription:
Nova theorematis Pythagoraei Dem. Bruns. Oct. 16
Seriem $x-\frac{1}{2}x^2+\frac{1}{12}x^3-\frac{1}{144}x^4\ldots$ summam consideravimus
invenimusque eam $=0$ si
[-$x/x$-][?] $2\sqrt{x}+\frac{3}{16}\frac{1}{\sqrt{x}}-\frac{21}{1024}\frac{1}{\sqrt{3x}}$[?] $=(k+\frac{1}{4})\pi$
Brunsv. Oct. 16.
Positis $l(1+x)=\varphi'x$ ; $l(1+\varphi'x)=\varphi''x$ ; $l(1+\varphi''x)=\varphi'''x$
&c. erit $\varphi^i x=\sqrt[3]{\frac{1}{\frac{3}{2}i}}$[?] $+$ Brunsv. Apr.
# Classes dari in quovis ordine; hincque
numerorum in terna quadrata discerpibilitas
ad theoriam solidam reducta Brunsv. Apr. 6
Demonstrationem genuinam compositionis virium
eruimus Gotting. Mai.
# Theorema la Grange de transformatione
functionum ad functiones quotcunque varia-
bilium extendi. Gotting. Mai.
# Series $1+\frac{1}{4}+\left(\frac{1.1}{2.4}\right)^2+\left(\frac{1.1.3}{2.4.6}\right)^2+\&c.=\frac{4}{\pi}$ Jun[?]
[-et ... generis[?]-]
simul cum theoria generali serierum [-angulos[?]-] {+involventium+} sinus et
cosinus angulorum arithmetice crescentium
# Calculus probabilitatis contra La Place defensus
Gott. Jun[?] 17.

items.english: We have considered the sum of the series x − ½x² + 1/12 x³ − 1/144 x⁴ … and found that it is 0 if 2√x + … = (k + ¼)π.

ad theoriam solidam reducta
items.english: Classes exist in every order; and hence the decomposability of numbers into three squares is reduced to a solid theory.

items.english: I have extended Lagrange's theorem on the transformation of functions to functions of any number of variables.
